title: EgoBrain-Mini: egocentric video, 32-channel EEG, wrist/arm IMU and audio during everyday actions (40 adults)
description: EgoBrain-Mini is a BIDS conversion of the lightweight egocentric release of EgoBrain. It contains synchronised first-person video, 32-channel EEG, four body-worn IMUs and audio from 40 adults performing 39 everyday seated actions, with 1,562 sub-actions and about 63 hours of EEG. The dataset supports research on multimodal human action understanding and brain-behaviour decoding. The IMU sampling rate varies across participants (about 200 Hz for P0001 and P0022 onward, about 10 Hz for P0002 to P0021), so per-file SamplingFrequency values should be used. The original release is preserved under sourcedata.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 256 Hz with an EMOTIV FLEX 2 Gel 32-channel headset, with CMS/DRL reference sensors on the earlobes. A GoPro mounted on the headset captured egocentric video (854x480, about 30 fps) and audio. Four IMUs were worn on the wrists and upper arms. Participants sat at a desk and followed a screen prompt, executed the action, then clicked end to delimit each sub-action.
